===== continuous_GNSS_Taiwan/README.txt (859 bytes)
README

Dataset: 2010–2024 continuous GNSS dataset for Taiwan 

Description:
This dataset contains daily GNSS position time series, and associated metadata for continuous GNSS stations in Taiwan.

Structure:
- metadata/: station metadata, offsets, and quality metrics
- time_series/: daily GNSS position time series
- documentation/: file_format_description, processing details

Time span:
2010–2024

Reference frame:
ITRF2020

Processing:
Precise Point Positioning (PPP) using GipsyX

Notes:
Raw GNSS observation data are maintained by the respective operating agencies and are not included in this dataset.

Contact:
Hsin Tung, Assistant Research Scientist
Institute of Earth Sciences, Academia Sinica
128, Sec. 2, Academia Road, Nangang,Taipei 11529, Taiwan
Tel: 886-2-2783-9910 ext. 1320
E-mail: cuzn@earth.sinica.edu.tw

===== SAMPLE continuous_GNSS_Taiwan/documentation/file_format_description.txt (4007 bytes)
======================================================================
1. RAW TIME SERIES FILES (*.series)
======================================================================

The raw time series files (*.series) follow the GipsyX StationSeries format and contain daily GNSS position solutions after basic quality control and outlier screening.

Column format:

1. decimal_year
2. east
3. north
4. up
5. sigma_east
6. sigma_north
7. sigma_up
8. corr_EN
9. corr_EV
10. corr_NV
11. jsec
12. year
13. month
14. day
15. hour
16. minute
17. second

Column descriptions:

decimal_year
    Observation epoch expressed as decimal year.

east
    East component of the station position time series.

north
    North component of the station position time series.

up
    Up component of the station position time series.

...
       S001.enu
7. The ENU coordinate system follows the local topocentric reference frame convention:
       E = east
       N = north
       U = up
